designSummary: Case-control study with frequency matching by year and operation type.
sampleSize: About 240 notes fit the 100 approved hours at 25 minutes each: 80 cases and 160 controls. If about 55 percent of controls were mobilised within 24 hours, the study has about 82 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05 to detect an odds ratio of 0.45 and about 71 percent power for 0.50; smaller associations will be estimated imprecisely and reported with their confidence intervals.
primaryAnalysis: Unconditional logistic regression of case status on early mobilisation, adjusted for year and operation type (matching factors) and for age, pre-fracture mobility, dementia and American Society of Anesthesiologists grade; about 11 cases per parameter.
secondaryAnalysis: Sensitivity analysis adding postoperative hypotension and delirium; the estimate restricted to patients whose delay was due to weekend staffing; the estimate in patients with dementia reported as exploratory; discharge destination by exposure.
missingData: Notes without a documented time of first mobilisation are counted and reported; the primary analysis excludes them, with sensitivity analyses coding them first as early and then as late.
multiplicity: One primary estimate; sensitivity and subgroup estimates reported with confidence intervals only.
software: R; the reading form, the directed acyclic graph and the analysis code archived before reading starts.
overfittingGuards: Adjustment set fixed from a directed acyclic graph before reading
Subgroups limited to weekend delay and dementia
summary: 80 cases and 160 controls; about 82 percent power for an odds ratio of 0.45; pre-surgical adjustment with postoperative conditions in sensitivity analysis.
